title: Joyful Female College Graduate in Gown, 1966 UCLA B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A radiant young woman in a graduation cap and gown laughs jubilantly on her graduation day, wearing a corsage of orchids pinned to her collar. The scene takes place outdoors in bright sunlight before the Romanesque Revival arches of Royce Hall at the University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA). Other graduates and well-wishers mill about in the sun-drenched courtyard. The snapshot captures an exuberant mid-1960s milestone during an era of significant social change on American university campuses.
